title.zh: 将东米萨米斯省卡加延-德奥罗市Gusa描笼涯国立中学更名为Gusa地区理科中学-X的法案
title.en: An Act Changing the Name of Gusa National High School in Barangay Gusa, City of Cagayan De Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental to Gusa Regional Science High School - X
title.orig: An Act Changing the Name of Gusa National High School in Barangay Gusa, City of Cagayan De Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental to Gusa Regional Science High School - X

source.name: LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation）

completenessNote: 全文，共 3 条；逐字取自 LawPhil 菲律宾法律虚拟图书馆（The LawPhil Project – Arellano Law Foundation） 官方页面（statutes/repacts/ra2012/ra_10267_2012.html），未改写、未摘译、未节选；原文语言：英语。 条文抬头依源文为 “Section N.” 等形式，本库统一规范为 “Section N.”；首行抬头与条内标题的分段依源文块级边界还原。

text.en: Renaming of a National High School. – The name of Gusa National High School in Barangay Gusa, City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental is hereby changed to Gusa Regional Science High School – X.

Location of the Main Campus. – The main campus of Gusa Regional Science High School – X shall continue to remain in its present location in Barangay Gusa, City of Cagayan de Oro, Province of Misamis Oriental.
Effectivity. – This Act shall take effect fifteen (15) days after its publication in the Official Gazette.
